title: Making Plans with Friends
context: Friends make plans all the time: what are you doing, shall we go, how about Sunday. Learn short suggestions and polite ways to say yes or no.
contextPersian: دوستان همیشه برنامه می‌چینند: چه می‌کنی، برویم، یکشنبه چطور است. پیشنهادهای کوتاه و روش‌های مؤدبانهٔ بله و نه گفتن را یاد بگیر.

expressions.english: What are you doing on Saturday?
expressions.example: What are you doing on Saturday? — Nothing special.
expressions.examplePersian: شنبه چه کار می‌کنی؟ — کار خاصی نه.
expressions.note: Present continuous can talk about plans.

expressions.english: I'm going to visit my parents.
expressions.persian: می‌خواهم به پدر و مادرم سر بزنم.
expressions.example: I'm going to visit my parents on Sunday.
expressions.examplePersian: یکشنبه می‌خواهم به پدر و مادرم سر بزنم.
expressions.note: going to + base verb = a plan.

expressions.english: Why don't we go to the cinema?
expressions.example: Why don't we go to the cinema tonight?
Shall we meet at six outside the station?
expressions.examplePersian: ساعت شش جلوی ایستگاه همدیگر را ببینیم؟
expressions.note: Shall we …? = Do you agree if we …?

expressions.example: I'm busy on Saturday. How about Sunday?
expressions.examplePersian: شنبه سرم شلوغ است. یکشنبه چطور است؟

expressions.example: The weather is nice. Let's go for a walk.
expressions.examplePersian: هوا خوب است. برویم قدم بزنیم.

expressions.example: A picnic on Friday? That sounds great!
expressions.examplePersian: پیک‌نیک روز جمعه؟ عالی به نظر می‌رسد!

expressions.english: I'd love to, but I can't.
expressions.example: I'd love to, but I can't. I have to work.
expressions.examplePersian: خیلی دوست دارم ولی نمی‌توانم. باید کار کنم.
expressions.note: A polite way to say no.

expressions.english: I'm afraid I can't. I have to work.
expressions.example: I'm afraid I can't on Friday. I have to work late.
expressions.examplePersian: متأسفانه جمعه نمی‌توانم. باید دیر وقت کار کنم.

expressions.example: I'm planning to learn to drive this year.
expressions.examplePersian: قصد دارم امسال رانندگی یاد بگیرم.

expressions.english: Do you want to come with us?
expressions.example: We're going to the lake. Do you want to come with us?
expressions.examplePersian: داریم به دریاچه می‌رویم. می‌خواهی با ما بیایی؟

expressions.example: Thanks for asking. Maybe another time!
expressions.examplePersian: ممنون که دعوت کردی. شاید یک وقت دیگر!

targets: Why don't we go to the cinema?
exercises.prompt: You want to suggest going to the cinema tonight. You say:
options: Why don't we go to the cinema tonight?
Why we don't go cinema tonight?
What about we going to cinema tonight?

targets: I'd love to, but I can't.
exercises.prompt: A friend invites you but you are busy. The politest answer is:
options: I'd love to, but I can't.
exercises.explanation: I'd love to, but … is polite.
exercises.explanationPersian: I'd love to, but … مؤدبانه است.

targets: I'm going to visit my parents.
acceptedAnswers: to

exercises.after: we meet at six outside the station?
acceptedAnswers: Shall

commonErrors.feedback: For a suggestion we say 'Shall we …?'.

acceptedAnswers: about

targets: Why don't we go to the cinema?
acceptedAnswers: Why don't we go to the cinema tonight?
Why don't we go to the movies tonight?
Why not go to the cinema tonight?
How about going to the cinema tonight?
Shall we go to the cinema tonight?

commonErrors.feedback: After 'Why don't we' use the base verb without 'to'.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: بعد از Why don't we فعل ساده می‌آید، بدون to.

acceptedAnswers: Maybe another time.
Maybe some other time.
Maybe next time.
Perhaps another time.
exercises.explanationPersian: Maybe another time یعنی شاید یک وقت دیگر؛ روشی مؤدبانه برای رد کردن دعوت.

exercises.source: قصد دارم امسال رانندگی یاد بگیرم.
acceptedAnswers: I'm planning to learn to drive this year.
I am planning to learn to drive this year.
I'm going to learn to drive this year.
I plan to learn to drive this year.

commonErrors.feedback: After planning use "to": planning to learn.
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: بعد از planning باید to بیاید: planning to learn.

targets: I'm afraid I can't. I have to work.
acceptedAnswers: I'm afraid I can't. I have to work.
I'm afraid I can't. I must work.
I'm sorry, I can't. I have to work.
Sorry, I can't. I have to work.
I'm afraid I can't. I've got to work.

exercises.prompt: Ali: "Shall we meet at six outside the station?" Reza: "I'm busy until seven. How about half past seven?" What time do they probably meet?
acceptedAnswers: Half past seven
At half past seven
Seven thirty
At seven thirty
exercises.explanationPersian: رضا ساعت هفت و نیم را پیشنهاد می‌کند.

targets: Why don't we go to the cinema?
exercises.incorrectSentence: Why we not go to the park?
acceptedAnswers: Why don't we go to the park?
Why do not we go to the park?
Why not go to the park?

commonErrors.feedback: The negative is formed with don't: Why don't we …?
commonErrors.feedbackPersian: منفی با don't ساخته می‌شود: Why don't we …؟

targets: I'm going to visit my parents.

speakingTask.instruction: Suggest a plan to a friend, accept or decline politely, and say what you are going to do.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: یک برنامه به دوستت پیشنهاد بده، مؤدبانه بپذیر یا رد کن و بگو قصد داری چه کار کنی.
modelSentences: What are you doing on Saturday?
Why don't we go to the cinema?
I'd love to, but I can't. I have to work.
How about Sunday? Shall we meet at six?

roleplay.aiRole: A friend who wants to do something at the weekend
roleplay.objective: Agree on a plan for the weekend: what, when and where
roleplay.context: Your friend wants to do something together this weekend. Suggest ideas, say when you are busy, politely say no to one idea and agree on a day, time and place.
roleplay.opening: Hi! Are you free this weekend? Do you want to do something together?
